messages:
alex.k: heads-up: we're starting a regional v2 rollout at 22:00 UTC to EU and APAC. initial weight 5% per region, feature-flagged. will enable the new response-header `x-rdwd-v2` for canary clients.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by alex.k for 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z -> rolling to eu-west1 and apac-east1, percentage: 5%, strategy: linear-5m, owner: @alex.k

samir.eng: copy — what's the rollback trigger? error rate / latency thresholds?

alex.k: prefer simple criteria: if client-facing 5xx rate up >2% absolute or p95 latency +60ms sustained for 10m, hit rollback. also auto-fallback to v1 route if model mismatch errors spike.

pm_jess: pls add a short blurb for release notes (customer-facing) and a changelog line for the SDK teams. don't want surprises.

maria_sdk: noted — quick ask: mobile SDK reads headers case-insensitively, but some older clients normalize header names. can we include a safe alias `x-rdwd-v2` + `x-rdwd-version`?

alex.k: yes, will emit both for 24h. pattern: `x-rdwd-v2: 1` and `x-rdwd-version: v2`. good call.

rachel_oncall: FYI, I'm on standby. will watch SLO dashboard and traces. if rollback triggered, I'll coordinate runbook steps.

samir.eng: adding a small preflight: run curl from eu and apac labs against canary endpoint to validate header presence and stage-specific routing. snippet: 
```
curl -I 'https://api.redwood.ai/v2/health?env=canary' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <canary-token>'
```
check for `x-rdwd-v2` and `x-rdwd-version`.

deploy-bot: preflight job created: canary-health-checks (eu,apac) -> running now. owner: samir.eng

pm_jess: also include a short rollback note in release notes: "If customers see increased errors, we will revert traffic to v1 for affected regions." keep it simple.

maria_sdk: will coordinate a small SDK patch to tolerate both headers; targeting ship in 2 hours. if we need to do an emergency pin, we can roll a compatibility header shim on gateway.

alex.k: decision timeline: start at 22:00 UTC, monitor 22:00–23:00. if green, increase to 20% at 23:30. if any trigger in that window -> immediate pause + notify customers affected.

samir.eng: telemetry note: please watch these metrics specifically: api.errors.5xx.rate, api.latency.p95, client.header-missing.rate, gateway.kv-mismatch. hooking alerts for >2% errors and p95 +60ms.

rachel_oncall: alert rules added. will page on-call if thresholds hit.

pm_jess: final ask: add a short line in release notes about the header alias and SDK patch. include contact: support@redwood.ai for customers who want an opt-out.

alex.k: done — I've updated internal release notes and the deploy description. starting canary now. ping back here with any anomalies. :crossed_fingers:

deploy-bot: canary rollout started: eu-west1=5%, apac-east1=5%. tracking id: c-roll-3255551234

samir.eng: quick check-in: eu health ok, headers present. apac shows a small spike in p95 +22ms but within acceptable range.

rachel_oncall: seeing a tiny bump in gateway error logs (model-variant-mismatch) for a subset of requests: ~0.3% traffic. watching.

alex.k: Ok — keep monitoring. do not advance to 20% until we hold steady for 30m.

(33 minutes later)
samir.eng: alert triggered: api.errors.5xx.rate in apac crossed 2.1% for 12m. investigating trace slices.

rachel_oncall: confirmed. paging owners, initiating rollback to v1 in apac. following runbook step 1: pause rollout and route apac traffic to v1.

alex.k: executing rollback for apac now. leaving eu canary running.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated: routing apac-east1 -> v1, reason: 5xx spike >2%, performed by alex.k.

pm_jess: please draft a short customer note for APAC: "We detected increased errors for some APAC requests after a small canary. Traffic has been reverted to v1 while we investigate. No action required from customers."

maria_sdk: pushed header-tolerance patch to CDN config to make header lookup tolerant; rolling out globally.

samir.eng: root cause looks like a model-mapping edge-case for shorter prompt lengths combined with quantized variant selection. reproducing in lab now.

alex.k: good catch. plan: hold EU canary at 5% until fix validated; keep APAC pinned to v1. create hotfix branch for model-selection fallback. if tests pass, re-run apac canary with fallback enabled.

rachel_oncall: I'll keep an eye on regression alerts. tagging this thread for postmortem notes.

pm_jess: thanks team. I'll send the customer bulletin now and update release notes with the rollback summary.

(Thread closed)
